checks.description: activation: AttackBaseMode.Sweep is the new branch. A unit that has arrived at the remembered enemy base, or at the mirrored probe cell, and can see no structure now walks the next rung of the search ladder as an attack-move instead of returning no orders. Last match the no-orders path produced 62,649 Hold("no objective assigned") evaluations across 180 actors, so if this id is absent the branch never reached its gate rather than being wrong.

outcome: the flagged regression and the direct measure of the change. Idle unit time was 46,305 seconds against a prior median of 9,710, three quarters of it from assault units that had arrived somewhere and stopped: e1 29,651 no-objective holds, arty 8,280, e3 5,258. A push that hunts is a push that is moving, so this is what must fall.

invariant: the sweep rung belongs to the side rather than the unit precisely so the army converges on one cell at a time. If that fails, units arrive alone and are killed piecemeal, and the first place it shows is the trade. 2.39 credits killed per credit lost last match against a fitness reference of 2.0; below the reference the change has bought movement with the army.

invariant: a sweep is only ever what a unit does instead of nothing. It is pre-empted by anything already inside the unit's own weapon range, it is abandoned the instant a structure enters sensor range, and it never deletes the side's sighting memory. If it has instead become a way of walking the push off targets it had, the structures killed fall. 26 last match against a fitness reference of 8.

invariant: credits lost already rose 67.6% to 33,350, and sending units to walk the map's rim is the obvious way to make that worse. Three of the four largest loss clusters were already deep in their half of the map, where the push had arrived and then stopped being shot at for free; movement should not cost more than standing did.

outcome: exploration is permanent and shroud-filtered resource reads mean unexplored cells are unusable income, so an army walking the search ladder should see at least as much of the map as one that stood still. 610 cells last match against a prior median of 279 and a fitness reference of 300.

outcome: every fitness component except survival scored 1.0 last match, and survival is match length, so the only way this change can raise the total is by not lowering it. 0.9738 last match against a prior median of 0.462. A total below 0.9 means a component that was capped has come off its cap.
